LanguageData.Rimverse_Endgame_Desc: Gates, wormholes, galactic crises and endings with credits (the game continues afterwards).
LanguageData.Rimverse_CrisisYears_Desc: How many in-game years pass before a galactic crisis can begin.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdActivateGateDesc: Spends {0} gate components to wake this system's gate.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdUseGateDesc: Passes through the active gate and arrives instantly at one of its linked destinations.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdEnterWormholeDesc: Passes through the wormhole to a distant point of the galaxy. It is unstable and will close within a few days.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdEnterWormholeStableDesc: Passes through the stable wormhole. This route stays open for good.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CmdStabilizeWormholeDesc: Spends {0} gate components to keep this wormhole open for good.
LanguageData.Rimverse_NeedGateParts: Needs {0} gate components on the map.
LanguageData.Rimverse_GateBeyond: Beyond the Local Group ({0} gate components)
LanguageData.Rimverse_GateBeyondBlocked: To go beyond you need the gate construction research and {0} gate components on the map.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterWormhole: A wormhole has opened near {0}, {1} light-years from home. It leads somewhere far away and will not last long.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CrisisStart_MechanoidSwarm: A mechanoid hive has awakened and calls itself {0}. It builds fleets without end and will consume civilization after civilization. Destroy its fleet before it reaches you.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CrisisStart_GreyPlague: A plague of grey nanomachines is spreading from {0}. Whole worlds lose population every quadrum. It ends only when the source is destroyed.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CrisisStart_ArchotechAwakening: An archotech mind has woken full of hatred and calls itself {0}. It is gathering ships and wants to remake the galaxy its own way.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CrisisStart_Invasion: Ships from outside the galaxy have crossed the void. They call themselves {0} and arrive with war fleets.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CrisisEnd_MechanoidSwarm: The mechanoid hive has fallen. Its fleets drift in space, without orders.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CrisisEnd_GreyPlague: The source of the grey plague has been destroyed. The worlds begin to recover.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CrisisEnd_ArchotechAwakening: The archotech mind has been silenced. The galaxy breathes again.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CrisisEnd_Invasion: The invaders have been driven back into the void.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Ending_CrisisDefeated: Against all odds, your people faced the greatest threat the galaxy had ever seen and won. For generations, worlds will tell the story of the crew that saved the stars.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Ending_Ascension: Your people merged their minds with an archotech intelligence. What they were ceased to exist, and what they became no longer fits in human words.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Ending_GalacticEmpire: From a patched-up ship to an empire of many worlds. Your colonies thrive and your allies swear loyalty. The galaxy has a new center.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Ending_BeyondTheGroup: The Great Gate opened to where no map reaches. Your ship passed through and left behind everything known. What lies on the other side is now your story.
LanguageData.Rimverse_EndingContinue: You may keep playing with this colony.
